The list comprehension will iterate over the range of the length of the tuple divided by the chunk size, using a step of the chunk size. For each iteration, it will slice the tuple from the current index to the current index plus the chunk size. If the last chunk is smaller than the specified size, it will be included as is.

ACTION: {"expression":"[test_tup[i:i+N] for i in range(0, len(test_tup), N)]"}
